# Shorenstein Center

> The Shorenstein Center at Harvard Kennedy School is a premier institution dedicated to advancing media, politics, and public policy through research, events, and educational opportunities.

Located at Harvard Kennedy School in Boston, the Shorenstein Center hosts the prestigious Theodore H. White Lecture on Press and Politics and provides comprehensive student engagement programs in journalism, media studies, and political communication. The center accepts donations through multiple channels to support its mission of strengthening the relationship between the press and politics.

## Key Topics

- Harvard Kennedy School
- Theodore H. White Lecture on Press and Politics
- Press and Politics
- Media and Democracy
- Documentary Filmmaking
- Journalism Education
- Political Communication
- Student Internships
- Research Programs
- Public Events
- Fireside Chats
- Tax-Deductible Giving
- Harvard University
- Boston, MA

## Events & Programming

- [Events](https://shorensteincenter.org/events): Events hub featuring the Theodore H. White Lecture on Press and Politics and campus programming including lectures, fireside chats, and public forums

## Student Opportunities

- [For Students](https://shorensteincenter.org/for-students): Student opportunities including internships, research positions, and educational programs at Harvard Kennedy School focused on media, politics, and public policy

## Support & Giving

- [Donate](https://shorensteincenter.org/donate): Multiple donation options including credit card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), wire transfer, check, and stock donations with tax-deductible benefits
